Fibre maintenance tonight on the SEA-PAO link: drain it by setting 'ip ospf cost 65535' on both ends (SEA:eth1, PAO:eth1). Expected: no traffic on SEA-PAO, all reachability unchanged, no other link above 90% utilisation.

@@ -8,5 +8,5 @@
